description: Build an overall response-distribution chart. Supply packet, rows, or csv using the documented field contract; for tidy facts include an overall row such as group_var=total and group_value=total.

column_id.description: Packet response column_id alternative to response.

csv.description: CSV with the same columns as rows: table_id, table_title, group_var, group_value, response, metric, value.

group_id.description: Packet group_id or normalized tidy group_var to compare, for example age.

group_label.description: Source-language group label alternative to group_id.

packet.description: Validated aggregate table packet. column_id keys must match row values keys.

response.description: Response source label to compare, for example 매우 만족.

row_id.description: Overall packet row_id; defaults to total.

rows.description: Tidy aggregate facts. Percent cells use metric=percent; bases use metric=base_n.

group_value.description: Group category. Use total for the overall row.

group_var.description: Grouping variable. Use total for the overall distribution and a value such as age for comparisons.

response.description: Response option label. Required when metric is percent/pct/pct_respondent; omit for base_n.

table_id.description: Stable source table or question ID.

value.description: Aggregate percentage or base count. Never respondent-level data.

table_id.description: Required with rows/csv when more than one table is present.

name: surveyviz_build_overall_chart_spec
